items.source: public final class KeysetScrollPosition extends Object implements ScrollPosition
items.translation: public final class KeysetScrollPosition extends Object implements ScrollPosition

items.source: A ScrollPosition based on the last seen key set. Keyset scrolling must be associated with a well-defined sort to be able to extract the key set when resuming scrolling within the sorted result set.
items.translation: 基于最后看到的键集设置的ScrollPosition。为了能够在排序后的结果集中恢复滚动时提取键集，键集滚动必须与一个定义明确的排序相关联。
